description: This file contains mock classes, utility functions, and factory for testing HTTP stream factory components within the Chromium project, specifically for the net/http module.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactoryPeer
classes.description: Provides static methods to manipulate and query HttpStreamFactory instances for testing.

classes.name: MockHttpStreamRequestDelegate
classes.description: Mock implementation of HttpStreamRequest::Delegate for testing.

classes.name: MockHttpStreamFactoryJob
classes.description: Mock implementation of HttpStreamFactory::Job for testing.

classes.name: TestJobFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create mock HttpStreamFactory::Job instances for testing.

methods.name: AddJobController
methods.description: Adds a JobController to the HttpStreamFactory for testing.

methods.name: IsJobControllerDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the JobController set in HttpStreamFactory is empty.

methods.name: GetDefaultJobFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the default JobFactory from HttpStreamFactory.

methods.name: MockHttpStreamRequestDelegate
methods.description: Constructor and destructor for the mock delegate.

methods.name: OnStreamReadyImpl
methods.description: Mocked method called when a stream is ready.

methods.name: OnStreamFailed
methods.description: Mocked method called when stream creation fails.

methods.name: OnNeedsProxyAuth
methods.description: Mocked method for proxy authentication needs.

methods.name: OnNeedsClientAuth
methods.description: Mocked method for client certificate requests.

methods.name: OnQuicBroken
methods.description: Mocked method indicating QUIC is broken.
